GpsPostCandidateResponse.description:
A deliberately sparse GPS point that can seed a new trip post.

This is distinct from the raw-sample response: it contains only the
fields needed by the map, is bounded server-side, and is never exposed to
viewers or share-link readers.
GpsPostCandidateResponse.title: GpsPostCandidateResponse

GpsPrivacyZoneEnvelope.description: Creation and replacement wrap the zone, matching the spec's examples.
GpsPrivacyZoneEnvelope.title: GpsPrivacyZoneEnvelope

PlatformPermission.description: Permissions that apply to the platform rather than a specific trip.
PlatformPermission.title: PlatformPermission

PostTimelineOpeningRouteResponse.description:
Geometry before the first visible post.

It carries no ``duration_seconds`` because there is no preceding post to
define a public timeline duration.
PostTimelineOpeningRouteResponse.title: PostTimelineOpeningRouteResponse

TrackSampleBatchResponse.description:
The four buckets add up to the request length.

That lets a client retire a whole queue slice and still reconcile its local
point count against the server's.
TrackSampleBatchResponse.title: TrackSampleBatchResponse

TravelMode.description:
Transport mode shared by itinerary legs, post routes, and GPS samples.

Values are stored as plain strings in ``String(32)`` columns, so adding a
member is a code change only and never needs a migration.
TravelMode.title: TravelMode

TripMemberUserResponse.description: Display-safe user data used when showing a trip's travellers.
TripMemberUserResponse.title: TripMemberUserResponse

put.description:
Replace a zone. This never creates one; an unknown id is a 404.

Existing retained coordinates are untouched: a zone only ever filters
uploads processed after it was stored.
